2 倍放大再锐化，不用模型，马上出结果: 2x upscale plus sharpening. No model needed, instant
一张一张放截下来的帧: Play the captured frames one by one
下载到数据目录的 video/ 下，只给面板自己用。: Saved under video/ in the data folder, used only by the panel.
不发这一帧（点一下发送）: This frame is skipped (click to send)
从当前位置新建一段范围（也可以在进度条上按 I / O 设起点终点）: New range from the current position (you can also press I / O on the progress bar)
先勾选要处理的帧: Check the frames to process first
先选好视频「{name}」里要发的帧: Pick the frames to send from "{name}" first
几乎一样的自动帧只留最清楚的一张，手动截的不删: Keeps only the sharpest of nearly identical auto frames; manual frames are never removed
发送时视频换成这些帧图片（画了标注的发标注图），视频本身不会被拷贝或改动: On send, the video is replaced by these frames (annotated frames are sent with annotations). The video itself is never copied or changed
发送这一帧（点一下不发）: This frame will be sent (click to skip)
取不到这一刻的画面: Couldn't get the picture at this moment
和 {time} 那张相比几乎没变: Almost no change since the frame at {time}
和时间上的前一张帧比，框出哪里变了: Compare with the previous frame and box what changed
在画面下方的进度条上按 I / O（或点「起点」「终点」）圈出一段，会记成一段命: Press I / O (or click “In” / “Out”) on the progress bar to mark a range. It is saved as a named range and is still here next time.
在这一帧上画框、箭头、写备注（发送时画进图里）: Draw boxes, arrows and notes on this frame (burned into the image on send)
在镜头切换、画面明显变了的地方截，适合剪辑过的视频和游戏实机。: Captures at cuts and clear visual changes; good for edited videos and gameplay.
增强会补出原来没有的细节，读文字、数字以原图为准: Enhancing can invent detail that was never there. Trust the original for text and numbers
尺寸不变，抹掉噪点和颗粒，不用模型；细节会略软: Same size, removes noise and grain without a model; details get slightly softer
工作流链已经不在了，请重新选一种增强方式: The workflow chain is gone. Choose another enhance method
左右拖动对比增强前后: Drag left and right to compare before and after enhancement
已经装了 FFmpeg？填上 ffmpeg 可执行文件的路径: Already have FFmpeg? Enter the path to the ffmpeg executable
截帧记录不对，请重新打开这个视频: The frame record is invalid. Open the video again
把视频拖进对话输入框就能截帧：播放器里手动截、按画面变化 / 录屏 / 均匀自动: Drop a video into the chat input to capture frames: capture by hand in the player, or automatically by scene change / screen recording / evenly; pick ranges, annotate, dedupe, compare changes, enhance with FFmpeg or ComfyUI, and send the chosen frame images instead. The agent can also capture frames from a video itself. Formerly built into the panel.
标注图不是有效的 PNG: The annotated image is not a valid PNG
标注的底图不对，请重新打开这一帧: The annotation base image doesn't match; reopen this frame
每个时间点在前后 0.25 秒里挑最清楚的一张。: Each point picks the sharpest frame within ±0.25 s.
没找到，打开截帧弹窗时可以下载: Not found. You can download it when opening the frame capture dialog
没有找到 FFmpeg：在截帧弹窗里下载一份，或者填上本机 ffmpeg 的路径: FFmpeg not found: download it in the frame capture dialog, or enter the path to ffmpeg on this computer
浏览器放不了这个格式: The browser can't play this format
浏览器放不了这个格式，拖动进度条看画面: The browser can't play this format; drag the progress bar to preview
空格 播放 · K 截帧 · ← → 上一帧 / 下一帧 · I / O 范围起: Space play · K capture · ← → prev / next frame · I / O range in / out
自动截几帧: How many frames to auto capture
自动截帧只在这段里截，范围外截过的自动帧留着。拖进度条上的两个把手可以调整。: Auto capture only works inside this range; auto frames outside it are kept. Drag the two handles on the progress bar to adjust.
视频在打开之后被改过，请重新打开: The video changed after it was opened. Open it again
读不出帧图片，比不了: Can't read the frame images to compare
跳过一动不动的画面，在操作发生的地方截，适合软件录屏。: Skips still screens and captures where something happens; good for screen recordings.
还没有安装本机生图（ComfyUI），请到设置 → 本机生图里一键安装: Local images (ComfyUI) aren't installed yet. Install them in Settings → Local images
还没有截帧：播放到要看的地方点「截取当前帧」（K），或者在右边点「自动截帧」: No frames yet: play to the moment you want and click “Capture frame” (K), or use “Auto capture” on the right
这个方式在本机 ComfyUI 里跑，要先在设置 → 本机生图里装好 Comfy: This method runs in local ComfyUI; install ComfyUI first under Settings → Local image generation
这个方式要先下载模型 {name}，下载一次之后离线也能用: This method needs the {name} model first; once downloaded it also works offline
这个路径的 ffmpeg 运行不起来：{path}: ffmpeg at this path doesn't run: {path}
这台电脑的系统没有现成的 FFmpeg 可以下载，请自己安装后填上路径: There is no ready-made FFmpeg download for this system. Install it yourself and enter its path
这是第一张，没有前一张可比: This is the first frame; nothing to compare with
面板用 FFmpeg 从视频里取帧图片，只读原视频、不改它。这台电脑上没找到可用: The panel uses FFmpeg to take frame images from the video. It only reads the original and never changes it. No working ffmpeg was found on this computer.
